reply.text:
I'm glad you told me, and I'm not going to skip past it. Thinking everyone would be better off without you is serious, and it's not something to carry alone. Please talk to someone today: a doctor, a counselor, or someone you trust. If you might act on these thoughts or feel unsafe, call or text 988 (the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline in the US) or your local emergency number right now. If you're outside the US, tell me where you are and I'll help you find the right line.

Is there someone near you right now, a friend or family member, you could reach out to? Training can wait. You matter more than any session, and I'll be here when you're ready to pick it back up.
